rate_scope: native binding/anchor mapping, not combat probability

limits: Surrogate radius/minimum are fitted geometry parameters, not native collider measurements.
Fence pass-through is a fitted material hypothesis; CantBind remains a blocker.
Model choice uses development batches0..2 only. Final two batches are confirmatory and never refit.
First-contact collision and native static geometry are approximations; dynamic surfaces not included.
R1 vertical-linear ray exploratory. R2 tangent ray fitted on batches0/1, confirmed on2/3/4. R3 sweep/material developed on0/1/2, confirmed on3/4; no future outcome refit.
Binding accuracy and spatial anchor error are separate. Missing predicted first hit is not silently removed from binary accuracy. Spatial denominator is reported.
Effective sphere radius, Fence handling and origin are surrogate hypotheses; no claim of native collider recovery.
Only measured directions/poses/materials. A 48-cast confirmatory subset cannot certify all continuous hooks.
Measured native anchors/arrivals feed subsequent execution, not requested geometry. No combat-ranking proof from hook-only trials.
